text:
Listen: I was like a sleeping sea.

You woke me, and the tempest broke loose.

I shake my waves, I sink my ships,

I climb to heaven and punish stars,

I grow ashamed and hide within my folds,

I go mad and kill my fish.

Do not look at me in fear. This is what you wanted.

translation.title: Listen: I Was Like a Sleeping Sea…
translation.editorial_note: The sea remains both speaker and body; the clipped verbs preserve the storm's escalating self-destruction.
